fusions.name: Driftwood Heave
fusions.desc: Hurls driftwood at an enemy up to 8 tiles away that deals 8 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at full reach. Holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Grip and Plunge
fusions.desc: Grips the target and drops on it with your full weight, which deals 15 damage, stuns it for 1.4 seconds and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Booming Challenge
fusions.desc: Booms a challenge that pulls up to 5 enemies within 8 tiles onto you and holds their attention for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Slow to Rouse
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you deal 6% more damage per stack, 36% at full, for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
